app.name: Sim Warning
setup.language.title: Choose your language
setup.language.hint: You can change this later in Settings.
setup.explanation.title: Stay aware of lost mobile service
setup.explanation.body: Sim Warning runs in the background and warns you if your phone loses its mobile network connection.
setup.intentional.title: Quiet when you choose
setup.intentional.body: No warnings in airplane mode. Switch monitoring off before manually disabling all SIMs.
setup.sound.title: Your sound settings apply
setup.sound.body: Warnings respect Do Not Disturb, silent mode and vibrate mode.
setup.interval.title: Choose a warning interval
setup.interval.body: If mobile service stays unavailable, sound and vibration repeat at this interval.
setup.interval.label: Warning interval
setup.visual.title: You also get a visual warning
setup.visual.body: Usually after 30 seconds. After startup or airplane mode, the app allows 5 minutes to reconnect.
setup.permissions.title: Allow essential access
setup.permissions.body: The app needs access to check mobile service and show warnings. Android will ask for the permissions needed on your phone.
setup.privacy: Your information stays on your phone. No account or tracking.
setup.permissions.required: Essential access is still needed. Review permissions to continue.
setup.permissions.unavailable: Monitoring is not available right now.
setup.permissions.startFailed: Monitoring could not start. Please try again.
status.stopped: Monitoring is not running. Switch it off and on to try again.
settings.title: Settings
warning.loss.title: No mobile service
warning.loss.body: Your phone has lost mobile service. If it does not return, check the SIM card and your phone's network settings.
warning.unknown.title: Mobile status unavailable
warning.unknown.body: The app cannot read mobile service status. Open the app to review access.
warning.sampleBody: This is a sample. Monitoring and live warnings are unchanged.
service.title: Monitoring is on
service.body: Watching mobile service. Tap to open.
permissions.explanation: Phone status lets the app observe SIM service. Notifications let it show warnings. No phone numbers, calls, contacts or location are read.
feedback.played: Preview requested, subject to your phone's sound settings.
feedback.posted: Test notification sent, subject to your notification settings.
feedback.suppressed: No sound was played. Check silent mode, Do Not Disturb and notification settings.
feedback.noAccess: Notification access is needed. Review Permissions.
help.purpose.title: What the app checks
help.purpose.body: The app watches mobile network service across your SIMs. One SIM with normal cellular voice or data registration is enough. Wi-Fi does not replace mobile service. Turning mobile data off alone does not mean service is lost. Emergency calls alone do not count as normal service.
help.timing.title: When warnings appear
help.timing.body: A usual loss gets 30 seconds before a visual warning. Sound and vibration repeat every 2, 4, 6, 8 or 10 minutes, as selected. After starting, restarting, re-enabling monitoring, restoring access or leaving airplane mode, the app allows 5 minutes; the first loss alert then occurs at 5 minutes. Service must stay back for 30 seconds before the warning quietly clears.
help.unknown.title: When status cannot be read
help.unknown.body: An unreadable status is different from confirmed service loss. Its visual warning appears after 30 seconds, or 5 minutes after startup. Its own sound and vibration repeat every 10 minutes. Review Permissions if this continues.
help.control.title: Your choices apply
help.control.body: Airplane mode pauses warnings automatically. Before manually disabling all SIMs, switch Monitoring off; Android does not reliably explain why a SIM disappeared. Switch it on again when ready. Do Not Disturb, silent mode, vibrate mode and your notification-channel choices apply. Dismissing a warning does not stop monitoring. A test warning or preview does not change a live warning.
help.repair.title: If service does not return
help.repair.body: Check airplane mode, coverage and your phone's SIM settings. A loose SIM is only one possible cause. Follow your phone maker's instructions if you remove and reinsert a physical SIM. Contact your mobile provider if needed.
help.background.title: Background operation
help.background.body: Monitoring uses service callbacks and schedules only the next deadline. You can close the screen. Enabled monitoring resumes after restart and unlock. After Force stop or a system stop, reopen the app. Android can delay warnings during deep sleep or battery restrictions; exact timing and battery use still need testing on your phone. The app has no internet access, account, tracking or ads.
help.access.title: Access and privacy
help.access.body: Allow phone status and notifications during setup. You can review them later in Permissions or Android app settings. If access is removed, the app must not report that monitoring is working. Language, interval and your monitoring switch stay on this phone. Backups are disabled. No SIM identifiers or phone numbers are stored.
